integrity: The proof is self-contained up to standard greedy arch factorization, additionally outlined. Optional symbolic checks use SymPy; separate exhaustive and dynamic checks use standard-library Python. No independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: All fixed-defect series rational; no assertion of bivariate rationality. Only first four specializations simplified. Defect-two integer sequence is already OEIS A001793; no numerical first-discovery claim. Literature may contain stronger implicit results.
title: Rational Dyck arch-deficit series and exact near-universality strata
